decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - No development involving any amendments to the construction or materials of the extension hereby permitted that are necessary to meet Building Regulations shall be undertaken until details are submitted to an approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 3 - 	Erection of a single storey side extension to house, as shown on drawing numbers, GT/002, GT/005, GT/006 & GT/007, received 23 May 2006 & GT/003 Rev A & GT/004 Rev A, received 17 July 2006, would not harm the architectural or historic character or the setting of the listed building, would maintain the amenity of neighbouring properties and is considered to preserve and enhance the appearance and character of Grove Park Conservation Area. Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 New Development, ENV-B.2.2 Conservation Areas, ENV-B.2.5 Development Affecting the Setting of a Listed Building, ENV-B.2.7 Alterations to Listed Buildings and Buildings of Local Townscape Character, and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations, and the Supplementary Planning Guidance.
description: Erection of single storey extension to kitchen to house.
